title: Amiga Boing Ball
summary: The original Amiga Boing Ball demo, written at the Winter CES in January 1984 to show off the Amiga's hardware, with a bouncing, spinning checkered ball running while the system multitasked. It became the Amiga's unofficial emblem.
why: HN people recall it with nostalgia as an impressive feat for its era, used as an example of the Amiga's graphics ability.

quote.text: I remember what were the effective limits at these times and to me it still looks impressive.
